deletedScenes.title: Alternate Opening - Maria Hill Interrogation
deletedScenes.description: The film was to open on the wrecked streets of New York after the battle, then cut to Maria Hill being questioned by an unseen interviewer about how the Tesseract crisis was handled and whether Nick Fury made the right call.
deletedScenes.whereToWatch: The Avengers (Avengers Assemble in the UK) Blu-ray bonus features: Deleted and Extended Scenes
deletedScenes.synopsis: This would have framed the whole film as Hill's account of events, told after the fact.

source.name: SciFiNow: Avengers Assemble deleted scenes review

deletedScenes.title: Extended Scene - Loki and Barton Strategize
deletedScenes.description: A longer version of the Loki, Selvig and Barton scene. In the added part, Barton tells Loki that Fury will be putting a team together, and Loki says he intends to test them.
deletedScenes.whereToWatch: The Avengers (Avengers Assemble in the UK) Blu-ray bonus features: Deleted and Extended Scenes
deletedScenes.synopsis: SciFiNow notes it spells out Loki's plan to let himself be captured, which the finished film leaves to the audience.

source.name: SciFiNow: Avengers Assemble deleted scenes review

deletedScenes.title: Steve Rogers - A Man Out of Time
deletedScenes.description: Steve Rogers sits alone going through files on his old comrades, almost all marked deceased apart from Peggy Carter, then looks at files on Howard and Tony Stark. Later he sketches at a cafe, where a waitress offers free wireless and he asks if she means the radio.
deletedScenes.whereToWatch: The Avengers (Avengers Assemble in the UK) Blu-ray bonus features: Deleted and Extended Scenes
deletedScenes.synopsis: The scene includes a different Stan Lee cameo from the one in the finished film.

source.name: SciFiNow: Avengers Assemble deleted scenes review

deletedScenes.title: Nick Fury & World Security Council
deletedScenes.description: The World Security Council pushes back on Fury's plan to assemble the team, and Fury points out that the brainwashed Barton chose not to kill him, suggesting he can be brought back.
deletedScenes.whereToWatch: The Avengers (Avengers Assemble in the UK) Blu-ray bonus features: Deleted and Extended Scenes
deletedScenes.synopsis: Most of what it states is already implied in the finished film.

source.name: SciFiNow: Avengers Assemble deleted scenes review

deletedScenes.title: Extended Viaduct Fight - Raw Footage
deletedScenes.description: Unfinished footage from the viaduct fight in which Hawkeye and Black Widow battle attackers, with rough temporary effects for Iron Man.
deletedScenes.whereToWatch: The Avengers (Avengers Assemble in the UK) Blu-ray bonus features: Deleted and Extended Scenes
deletedScenes.synopsis: This is raw footage, not a finished scene.

source.name: SciFiNow: Avengers Assemble deleted scenes review

deletedScenes.title: Fury & Hill Discuss the World Security Council
deletedScenes.description: On the Helicarrier, Fury confronts Hill for telling the Council about Barton, and she asks whether he has told them who is on his response team.
deletedScenes.whereToWatch: The Avengers (Avengers Assemble in the UK) Blu-ray bonus features: Deleted and Extended Scenes
deletedScenes.synopsis: It fits with the alternate opening's framing, which gives Maria Hill a much bigger role.

source.name: SciFiNow: Avengers Assemble deleted scenes review

deletedScenes.title: Extended Scene - Banner and Security Guard
deletedScenes.description: After landing in the warehouse, Bruce Banner talks longer with the security guard played by Harry Dean Stanton, who ends up handing him the keys to his motorbike.
deletedScenes.whereToWatch: The Avengers (Avengers Assemble in the UK) Blu-ray bonus features: Deleted and Extended Scenes
deletedScenes.synopsis: The extra lines explain where Banner's motorbike in the final battle came from.

source.name: SciFiNow: Avengers Assemble deleted scenes review

deletedScenes.title: Alternate Ending - Maria Hill Interrogation
deletedScenes.description: The film returns to Maria Hill's interrogation. She gives her official verdict on the team over the closing scenes, including Thor and Loki leaving for Asgard.
